'''Rove''' was an [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] to the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He replaced [[Unar]] in that position after his predecessor was executed by [[Supreme Mogul]] [[Karagga]].

==Biography==
Rove was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Imperial Diplomatic Service]] during the [[Galactic War]], between [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> In [[3639 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|1.1}}</ref> the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] started attacking and [[Annexation of neutral systems|annexing]] neutral [[Star system/Legends|systems]] and its leader&mdash;the [[Supreme Mogul]] [[Karagga]]&mdash;had the Imperial [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] [[Unar]], killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

Serving as Unar's replacement Ambassador to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], he assigned the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[YD-33]] to recruit Imperial champions on [[Vaiken Spacedock]]. He met with his recruits and the Hutt Cartel's envoy, Ambassador [[Grub (Ambassador)|Grub]], aboard the [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] vessel ''[[Ziost Shadow]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Personality and traits==
[[Color/Legends|Fair]]-skinned and with dark brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], Rove was a diplomat but believed in the use of violence when deemed necessary.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
